more.good_when: A maintainer who breaks any behavior that invoicer/ holds sees a test fail. Today all 51 tests still pass when a row number in a refusal stops counting blank rows that Calc saves as one repeated row (sheet.py:88), so the refusal names the wrong row; when a run of identical adjacent cells that Calc saves as one repeated cell fills only its first column (sheet.py:105), so a price or quantity beside an equal value is lost; when spaces around a header name or a description stop being trimmed (sheet.py:115, sheet.py:153); and when parse_lines drops the quantity or total drops the tax (lines.py:28, totals.py:16), which invoicer still offers in its __all__.
